verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a local programmatic endpoint (local API, socket, or query interface) that an agent can call for codes and secrets. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: the Ente CLI only exports and decrypts backups, the enteauth://search deep link opens a search in the app, and localhost:3003 is the self-hosted web app, not a vault query API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
